source.publication: Texas is open for small business (Fiscal Notes, 2025), Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts
source.section: 'Texas is small-business friendly by the numbers' figure, under '0%': Texas has no personal income tax (no state return or form lines exist)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 120,000.00 + interest 4,000.00 = 124,000.00. Federal taxable income = 124,000.00 - 15,750.00 single standard deduction = 108,250.00 (given, not tested). Texas imposes no personal income tax, so there is no state return: state taxable income 0.00, tax before credits 0.00, credits 0.00, state income tax 0.00 regardless of income.
